issue.title: 🚀 Feature: Settlement date range filter
issue.body:
## Bounded Context
Settlement domain. Merchant actor. No cross-domain side effects.

## User Stories

### Story 1: Filter settlements by date range

- As a **Merchant**, I want **to filter my settlement list by a custom date range** so that **I can quickly find historical transactions**

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Merchants can select a start date and end date using a date picker on desktop browsers
- [ ] Merchants can select a date range using a native date input on mobile browsers
- [ ] The settlement list updates in real time as the date range changes
- [ ] Invalid ranges (start after end) show an inline error
- [ ] The selected range persists across page refreshes via URL query params

#### Scenarios

```gherkin
Scenario: Merchant filters settlements with a desktop date picker
  Given a Merchant views the settlement list on a desktop browser
  When the Merchant selects a start date and an end date
  Then the settlement list shows only settlements inside the range

Scenario: Merchant filters settlements with a mobile date input
  Given a Merchant views the settlement list on a mobile browser
  When the Merchant selects a date range with the native date input
  Then the settlement list shows only settlements inside the range

Scenario: Invalid range shows an inline error
  Given a Merchant selected an end date before the start date
  When the Merchant applies the range
  Then an inline error is shown
  And the settlement list does not change

Scenario: Selected range survives a page refresh
  Given a Merchant applied a date range
  When the Merchant refreshes the page
  Then the same range is applied from the URL query params
```

## Edge Cases

- Mobile browsers that do not support the `date` input type fall back to a text field with DD/MM/YYYY validation
- Date ranges spanning more than 12 months show a warning but are not blocked
- Selecting today as the end date includes all settlements up to the current moment

## Domain Events

- Emits: `SettlementListFiltered` — emitted when a Merchant applies or changes a date range
- Consumes: —

## Trace Plan

1. [ ] ☄️ Skeleton — Filter settlements by date range: proves the filter path from date picker to settlement list (claims: "Merchant filters settlements with a desktop date picker")
2. [ ] ☄️ Deepening — validation and persistence (claims: "Invalid range shows an inline error", "Selected range survives a page refresh")
3. [ ] ☄️ Mobile date input (claims: "Merchant filters settlements with a mobile date input")
